entry_sequence.action: Identify a Fair Value Gap (FVG) formed by the gap between the closing point of the first candle and the opening point of the third candle in a three-candle sequence.
entry_sequence.rationale: The FVG represents an imbalance where price moved aggressively in one direction without proper trading activity.
